execution.raw_text:
```sql
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id,
  md.pref_name,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md.max_phase,
  di.mesh_heading,
  md.first_approval
FROM molecule_dictionary md
JOIN drug_indication di ON md.molregno = di.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
ORDER BY md.first_approval DESC, md.chembl_id ASC
```
